text: {"differences": [{"reason": "The English text contains claims about what is regulated (planning objectives, competencies, timetable, involvement, adaptation procedure) and an obligation for the applicant to initiate the sectoral plan procedure at SFOE, which are not present in the French text.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "This regulates the planning objectives, competencies, timetable for the next steps in the procedure, involvement and information of the communalities, and the procedure for adapting the cantonal planning.", "before": ""}, "severity": 1.0}, {"reason": "The English text contains an obligation \"the applicant initiates the sectoral plan procedure at the SFOE\" which is not present in the French text.", "type": "omission", "en": {"quote": "the applicant initiates the sectoral plan procedure at the SFOE", "before": "In the next step,"}, "severity": 1.0}, {"reason": "The French text contains obligations and claims not present in the English text, such as offices taking position within two months, OFEN forming a support group within two months, organizing a visit to potential planning zones, and the requirement that the recommended planning zone must be large enough to allow development of multiple corridors.", "type": "addition", "tgt": {"quote": "doivent prendre position dans un délai de deux mois", "before": "L’Office fédéral de l’énergie (OFEN) transmet le dossier aux offices représentés au sein de la Confédération pour l’organisation du territoire (COT), qui"}, "severity": 1.0}]}
